name: CDB
recent: CelcomDigi 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利按年增长 19.6% 至 RM408m，并宣布每股 3.4 仙的第三次中期股息。公司同时出现董事会变动，两名董事于 11 月 18 日辞任。EPF 在 11 月内多次申报持股变动。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利按年增长 19.6% 至 RM408m。
宣布第三次中期免税单层股息每股 3.4 仙。
两名董事 MRS JUNE SOLBEKK 和 MISS ELISABETH MELANDER STENE 于 11 月 18 日辞任。
risks: EPF 在 11 月内多次申报持股变动，需留意后续股权变化。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 19.6% 至 RM408m，营收按年增长 1.5%。上一季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM3,186m，净利 RM398m，净利率 12.5%，净利按季下降 4.8%，按年下降 9.3%。

recent_en: CelcomDigi reported 3Q 2026 net profit up 19.6% YoY to RM408m and declared a third interim dividend of 3.4 sen per share. Two boardroom changes occurred on 18 Nov. EPF filed several changes in its substantial shareholder interest during November.
notable_en: Reported 3Q 2026 results with net profit up 19.6% YoY to RM408m.
Declared a third interim tax-exempt single-tier dividend of 3.4 sen per share.
Two directors, Mrs June Solbekk and Miss Elisabeth Melander Stene, resigned on 18 Nov.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest during November; further changes in shareholding should be monitored.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 net profit rose 19.6% YoY to RM408m, with revenue up 1.5% YoY. For the prior quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3,186m and net profit RM398m, a net margin of 12.5%; net profit fell 4.8% QoQ and 9.3% YoY.
